queries: WITH per_item_town AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), per_town AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM per_item_town GROUP BY town_city) SELECT town_city, avg_price, avg_ratio, avg_ratio - (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_town) AS ratio_above_overall_avg FROM per_town WHERE avg_ratio > (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_town)

WITH item_town AS (
  SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city,
         AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price,
         AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
  JOIN Invoices i ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city
),
town AS (
  SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM item_town
  GROUP BY town_city
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_ratio FROM town
)
SELECT t.town_city, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - o.overall_ratio AS ratio_above_average
FROM town t CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE t.avg_ratio > o.overall_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: The 'average across all towns' is the unweighted mean of the per-town average ratios (each town counts equally), not the mean over all line items.
Towns whose ratio is entirely missing (NULL) are excluded from the cross-town average and cannot exceed it. A zero derived_total_cost is treated as a missing ratio to avoid division errors.
The customer is reached via Invoice_Line_Items.order_item_id -> Order_Items -> Orders -> Customers (not via Invoices.order_id); both paths should agree for consistent data.

assumptions.assumption: The customer is reached via Invoice_Line_Items -> Invoices -> Orders -> Customers, using the invoice's order.
The cross-town average is the unweighted mean of the per-town average ratios (each town counts once).
Rows with a zero derived_total_cost would error or yield NULL in the ratio; NULL ratios are ignored by AVG, and no further filtering is applied.
